desc: Read N, p, and matrix A.
Construct matrix M: if $p=2$, set $M_{i,j} = 1$ if $A_{i,j} == 0$ else $A_{i,j}$. If $p > 2$, set $M_{i,j} = 0$ if $A_{i,j} == 0$ else $A_{i,j}$.
Compute $R = M^p \pmod p$ using binary exponentiation (matrix multiplication).
Write the complete Python script implementing the logic above.
Run the code against Sample 1, Sample 2, and Sample 3 to verify correctness.
If samples fail, debug and correct the matrix construction or exponentiation logic.
